Finite pairing with the existing READY identity only. Provision no_backup/pairing-config.json with the approved public certificate, exact pin and 127.0.0.1 HTTP/HTTPS ports forwarded to the isolated fixture. Enter its four-digit pairing PIN here, then approve a fresh screen-lock prompt. The 30-second authorization includes signing, real pairing and one client-certificate HTTPS application-list read. No automatic retry, unpair or playback occurs. Cancellation can leave host enrollment intact.
